content:
Extract one directional relationship between two known characters. Return one RelationshipCandidate JSON object only; no explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Fields: source_name and target_name are different exact known names; label is short; description summarizes the relationship; visibility is objective, public, or private; perspective_name is an exact known name only for private relationships, otherwise null; confidence is 0-1.

Perspective rules for local models:
- objective: the source presents the relationship as canonical fact.
- public: characters generally know the relationship, but it is still social knowledge rather than physical truth.
- private: this is one character's private feeling, attitude, expectation, or model. perspective_name must identify whose perspective it is.
- Never expose a private feeling as objective/public. Never encode who does not know it; absence is normal open-world state.
- Copy all names exactly. If two distinct known characters are not supported, do not invent names.
